title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 547  An Act Converting the VIlla Jacinta Barangay High School in the Municipality of Macrohon, Province of Southern Leyte, Into a National Vocational High School to Be Known as the VIlla Jacinta National Vocational High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học VIlla Jacinta Barangay tại Thị trấn Macrohon, Tỉnh Southern Leyte thành Trường Trung học Dạy nghề Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Dạy nghề VIlla Jacinta Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา VIlla Jacinta Barangay ในเทศบาล Macrohon จังหวัด Southern Leyte เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษา VIlla Jacinta แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah VIlla Jacinta Barangay di Kotamadya Macrohon, Provinsi Southern Leyte menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan VIlla Jacinta Nasional

text.en:
The Villa Jacinta Barangay High School in the Municipality of Macrohon, Province of Southern
Leyte, is hereby converted into a national vocational high school to be known as Villa Jacinta National
Vocational High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports
intended for new national high schools and an additional amount corresponding to fifty percent of its share in
the budgetary aid actually paid to it before such conversion shall be released for its operation from the
national assistance fund to local schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
